title: Number of Elapsed Seconds Between Two Times
summary: Given valid 24-hour start and end timestamps formatted HH:MM:SS on the same day, return elapsed seconds. End is guaranteed not earlier than start, so no midnight wrap is required.
officialConstraints: Both strings length8; hours0..23, minutes/seconds0..59; end>=start.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
